description: This file defines the cSettings class, which manages configuration settings stored in a JSON-like structure, providing methods to read, write, and manipulate key-value pairs, and persist them to a file.

classes.name: cSettings
classes.description: A class that manages configuration settings stored in a JSON object, allowing reading, updating, and persisting key-value pairs to a file.

methods.name: cSettings
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the settings object, attempting to read from a file or creating a new file if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key from the JSON data.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set a key's value with string, int, or bool types, and then write the updated data to the file.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists and is non-empty in the JSON data.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the JSON data and updates the file.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Serializes the JSON data to the file if it exists.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Initializes the JSON object from the configuration file.
